ratios.facility: Revolving Credit Facility (Third Amended Credit Agreement)
ratios.quote: the ratio of consolidated funded indebtedness (minus up to $ 300 million of unrestricted cash and cash equivalents available on such date) to consolidated EBITDA for the prior four consecutive quarters must not be greater than 3.50 to 1.00 (the “Consolidated Net Leverage Ratio”)

ratios.facility: Revolving Credit Facility (Third Amended Credit Agreement)
ratios.quote: the ratio of consolidated EBITDA for the prior four consecutive quarters to consolidated interest expense paid or payable in cash for the prior four consecutive quarters must not be less than 3.00 to 1.00 (the “Consolidated Interest Coverage Ratio”)

parsed.notes: Actual ratios not disclosed; company states it was in compliance with all covenants as of September 26, 2026 with no amounts outstanding under the Revolving Credit Facility. The Consolidated Leverage Ratio is used only for pricing margin/commitment fee and is excluded.
